subpages.text: Skip to content (800) 688-9282 CATV Fiber Optic Transmitters and Receivers RF signal loss increases with frequency and distances. Fiber Optic (FO) cables have very low signal loss compared to coaxial cable and transmit RF signals greater distances. Even better, and not typically thought of, RF signals over fiber can be run through noisy RF environments without interference regardless of distance. Incorporating Fiber Optic transmitter and receivers in your distribution system ensures high quality signal transmission providing reliability and an excellent performance to price ratio. FT-FTX-6-SCAPC FT-FTX-10-SCAPC-V2 Indoor CATV Fiber Optic Transmitter GET FULL SPECS The FT-FTX-* series are state-of-the-art, rack-mounted, CATV fiber optic transmitters designed for the fiber optic distribution of broadband RF signals. Units accept a flat RF signal within the 47-860 MHz bandwidth and transmit signal using optical cabling over single-mode fiber at 1310 nm. This series has transmitter models with output levels of 6dB or 10dB. FT-HHRX-1000-SC-MINI Indoor CATV Fiber Optic RX Node GET FULL SPECS The FT-HHRX-1000-SC-MINI is an indoor CATV fiber optic node with a receive frequency range of 47-1,000 MHz. This unit is perfect for commercial and residential fiber applications needing a low loss virtually noise-free CATV transmission system. FT-HHRX-870-1-SCAPC Indoor CATV Fiber Optic RX/TX Node with Reverse Path GET FULL SPECS The FT-HHRX-870-1-SCAPC is a state-of-the-art fiber node with a receive frequency range of 54 to 870 MHz, and a reverse frequency range of 5-42 MHz. This unit features an integrated return path transmitter. subpages.title: FiberTronix L-Band RF Fiber Optic TX/RX | NACE
subpages.desc: FiberTronix L-Band RF fiber optic transmitter and receiver system extends multiple satellite TV signals up to 12.5 miles over single-mode fiber.
h: Transmit, extend and receive multiple satellite TV signals in the L-Band over a single optical fiber
subpages.text: Skip to content (800) 688-9282 Transmit, extend and receive multiple satellite TV signals in the L-Band over a single optical fiber GET FULL SPECS Transmit, extend and receive multiple satellite TV signals in the L-Band over a single optical fiber up to 12.5 miles using FiberTronix fiber optic Transmitters and Receivers FT-SAT-TX-6 L-Band Fiber Optic Transmitter The FiberTronix FT-SAT-TX-6 L-Band fiber optic transmitter carries 6 Satellite RF carriers in the 174 – 2350MHz frequency range over a single-mode fiber from the dish LNB to a FiberTronix FT-SAT-RX-6 L-Band fiber optic Receiver for coaxial cable distribution through L-Band switches to satellite receivers. High frequency L-Band satellite signals typically travel only a few hundred feet before needing amplification, which causes noise, and is limited to 2 cascading amplifiers using coaxial cable, before significant signal deterioration occurs. By transporting the L-Band satellite signal over a single-mode optical fiber this distance will extend up to 12.5 miles. One FT-SAT-TX-6 transmitter can deliver high quality RF to a maximum of 32 optical receivers (Receiver model: FT-SAT-RX-6). GET FULL SPECS FT-SAT-TX-6 L-Band Fiber Optic Receiver The FiberTronix FT-SAT-RX-6 L-Band fiber optic Receiver outputs up to 6 RF Satellite signals that are received over a single-mode fiber from a corresponding FiberTronix multiplex Transmitter (FT-SAT-TX-6) in the range of 174 – 2350MHz and uses Automatic Gain Control for power level stability. GET FULL SPECS FT-FOATT-MF-SC-APC-10 10dB Fiber Attenuator IMPORTANT: If you are connecting one transmitter to only one receiver, and not multiple receivers using a splitter, a 10dB fiber attenuator is required to not overdrive the receiver. Optional Polarity Locker and Power Supply: Polarity
